title: DH2 character document
description: dh2_roll_api character schema v4 — generated from CHARACTER_FIELDS (api/lib/character-schema.mjs). Permissive: unknown keys are validator warnings, not schema errors.

schemaVersion.description: Document schema version (current: 4). Migrations keep old documents loadable.

xp.description: Experience: earned total (starting grant included), spent (defaults to the ledger sum), and the per-purchase ledger.

items.description: One purchase — "Mighty Shot", 600. Typed fields (builder addendum) make it a cost-audited advancement record; untyped legacy entries stay valid.

kind.description: What kind of advance was bought (unknown kinds warn, for forward compatibility).

ref.description: What was bought: a corpus ref (dh2:<type>:<snake_id>), a characteristic key (ws…fel), or a skill name (+speciality).

rank.description: Advance rank purchased (characteristic 1–5 Simple→Expert, skill 1–4; psy rating = the new rating).

matches.description: Aptitude matches at purchase time — the cost audit trail.

items.description: Aptitudes with their origin (source ∈ homeworld|background|role|elite_advance|extra; legacy casings normalize at migration).

origin.description: Character-creation origin. Members are { name, ref? } or null; bare strings normalize to { name } at migration. ⇄ Foundry bio.homeWorld/background/role/elite.

items.description: Elite advances taken (Psyker, Untouchable, …) with their XP cost.

influence.description: Influence (the DH2 social resource-characteristic). ⇄ Foundry characteristics.influence.base.

items.description: Weapon Training groups held ("Bolt", "Las", …) — mapped to Weapon Training (X) talent Items in Foundry.

extensions.description: Opaque campaign extensions (Dramatic Moments, builder wizard state under extensions.builder, …). Preserved verbatim, never validated.

player.description: Player attribution — PRIVACY-GUARDED: validation warns unless { allowPlayer: true }; omitted by default (pipeline decision D9).

tarot.description: The Emperor's Tarot / divination drawn at creation (⇄ Foundry bio.divination).

items.description: Worn armour as items: AP + covered locations ("all" or head/body/…). Equipped items derive per-location AP (highest wins — armour does not stack); the flat `armour` block is a manual override used when no item is equipped.

dsl.description: Item-granted rules in the DSL. Applied at roll time ONLY while the item is equipped — e.g. `quality "Good Auspex" { on test.MODIFIERS when is_test("Tech-Use") then add modifier "auspex" = 20 }`.

items.description: Equipment. equipped=true (default) counts weight × quantity toward encumbrance; false = stored (quarters/ship).

dsl.description: Item-granted rules in the DSL. Applied at roll time ONLY while the item is equipped — e.g. `quality "Good Auspex" { on test.MODIFIERS when is_test("Tech-Use") then add modifier "auspex" = 20 }`.

fatigue.description: Fatigue levels. Threshold is DERIVED: TB + WB (p.233; fatigueThreshold()).

psy.description: Psy rating (0 = not a psyker), psyker class, powers currently sustained.

ref.description: Corpus ref — resolves mechanically to compendium UUIDs (deterministic slug ids; no name-matching).

dsl.description: Entry-granted rules in the DSL (custom talents/traits/powers) — compiled into the customRules layer at roll time; portable between the Pages UI and Foundry.

items.description: Known psychic powers. equipped=true (default) = in the active loadout / prepared; the power.* pipeline consumes these in Phase 6.

insanity.description: Insanity points and acquired Mental Disorders.

items.description: Lasting critical-injury effects (⇄ Foundry criticalInjury Items).

size.description: Size trait value (DH2 p.138; 4 = Average). Display + future to-hit modifiers.

movementModifier.description: Manual movement adjustment: acts as an Agility-Bonus delta for the movement brackets ONLY (does not stack into any other AgB calculation).

wounds.description: Wound track (carried, not yet consumed by the attack loop).

critical.description: Critical damage taken beyond 0 wounds (the crit-table severity).

ref.description: Corpus ref — resolves mechanically to compendium UUIDs (deterministic slug ids; no name-matching).

dsl.description: Entry-granted rules in the DSL (custom talents/traits/powers) — compiled into the customRules layer at roll time; portable between the Pages UI and Foundry.

talents.description: Talent list. "Name (X)" strings or {name, …} objects (ref/dsl per the builder addendum).

ref.description: Corpus ref — resolves mechanically to compendium UUIDs (deterministic slug ids; no name-matching).

dsl.description: Entry-granted rules in the DSL (custom talents/traits/powers) — compiled into the customRules layer at roll time; portable between the Pages UI and Foundry.

traits.description: Trait list (innate DH2.0 traits, e.g. Brutal Charge (3), Daemonic (4)). Traits are granted, never XP-purchased.

weight.description: Weapon weight — counts toward encumbrance while equipped.

equipped.description: On the character (counts weight; available in combat). false = stored.

clip.description: Magazine size and rounds remaining (consumed when ammo tracking lands).

dsl.description: Item-granted rules in the DSL. Applied at roll time ONLY while the item is equipped — e.g. `quality "Good Auspex" { on test.MODIFIERS when is_test("Tech-Use") then add modifier "auspex" = 20 }`.

class.description: Weapon class; "melee" and "thrown" drive Strength-Bonus damage.

sbMultiplier.description: Strength-Bonus multiple added to damage for melee/thrown (default 1 for melee).

field.description: Force field (absorbs on roll ≤ rating; overloads on roll ≤ overloadMax).

source.description: Import provenance (adapter name, source identifiers, timestamp).

items.description: Manual modifiers BY SOURCE — e.g. { value: 5, source: "Custom Grip" }.

additionalProperties.description: A DH2 skill (canonical names: Acrobatics, Athletics, Awareness, Charm, Command, Commerce, Common Lore, Deceive, Dodge, Forbidden Lore, Inquiry, Interrogation, Intimidate, Linguistics, Logic, Medicae, Navigate, Operate, Parry, Psyniscience, Scholastic Lore, Scrutiny, Security, Sleight of Hand, Stealth, Survival, Tech-Use, Trade). Target derived RAW: untrained = ½ characteristic; advances 1–4 → +0/+10/+20/+30 (use skillTarget).
